settings.html: Start early

settings.title: Build Comfort Into Your Space From Day One

settings.editor: When you're building or remodeling, your heating system isn't just an appliance you buy off a shelf—it's the backbone of your home’s indoor comfort. If a heating system is slapped together without checking the floor plan or air movement, you end up with cold bedrooms, noisy vents, and high utility bills.

Unlike replacing an old furnace where the ductwork and wires are already in place, a new heating installation is about building your home's comfort system from scratch. It means making sure your furnace or heat pump is sized just right, your ductwork is designed to move air evenly, and every room stays cozy without spiking your monthly energy bills.

At Lenz Heating & Cooling, we work hand-in-hand with homeowners, custom home builders, and local contractors across Greater Des Moines. From the first blueprint review to the final walkthrough, our local, veteran-led team makes the whole installation process simple, transparent, and completely stress-free.

Lenz Heating & Cooling takes the guesswork out of new heating installations. We break down your options in plain English, coordinate directly with your builders, and install a system you can rely on for years to come.
Working with an experienced HVAC team early in your project helps you:

settings.html:
• Get the Exact Size You Need: We calculate your home's square footage, insulation, and window layout so your heater runs at peak efficiency.
  • Pick the Right System for Your Budget: Easily compare gas furnaces, cold-climate heat pumps, and dual-fuel options.
  • Enjoy Even Temperatures in Every Room: Custom duct design ensures warm air reaches upper floors, corner rooms, and basements equally.
  • Protect Your Indoor Air Quality: Integrate whole-home humidifiers to prevent dry winter air, static shocks, and wood floor damage.
  • Avoid Price Surprises: Know all your equipment and labor costs upfront before construction even starts.
When it is needed

settings.title: When Is a New Heating Installation Needed?

settings.editor: Not sure if you need a replacement or a brand-new installation? Here is when a dedicated heating system installation comes into play:

settings.html: 1

settings.title: You’re Building a New Custom Home

settings.editor: Planning your HVAC system while your home is still on paper is the best way to get flawless comfort. Designing early allows us to route ductwork cleanly behind walls, place vents where they won't block furniture, and set up your gas and electrical lines before drywall goes up.

settings.html: 2

settings.title: You’re Finishing a Basement or Adding a Room

settings.editor: If you’re finishing a basement, building a master suite over the garage, or adding a sunroom, your existing furnace might not have enough push to heat the new space. We can help you decide whether extending your current ductwork, adding zone controls, or installing a quiet ductless mini-split is the smartest move.

settings.html: 3

settings.title: Your Property Has Never Had Central Heat

settings.editor: If you have an older home or rural property that currently relies on space heaters, old radiators, or room units, putting in a centralized heating system changes everything. You get consistent warmth across every room and simple control right from a smart thermostat.

settings.html: 4

settings.title: You Have Ductwork Ready, But Need Equipment Set Up

settings.editor: If you're renovating a home or finishing a space where duct lines are already run, setting up the right heating equipment is quick and straightforward. We’ll check your existing duct capacity, wiring, and gas lines to make sure everything is safe and ready for a brand-new furnace or heat pump.

settings.html: Done right

settings.title: Why Proper Heating Installation Makes All the Difference

settings.editor: Even the highest-rated, most expensive furnace won't perform well if it's hooked up improperly. Taking the time to engineer and test a new installation properly means:

settings.html:
• No Cold Spots: Your home heats evenly from the main living area down to the basement.
  • Lower Monthly Energy Bills: Properly sized equipment and sealed ducts keep fuel from being wasted behind walls.
  • Safe Operation: Flue vents, gas lines, and electrical connections are thoroughly tested so your family stays safe.
  • Fewer Unexpected Breakdowns: Systems built with proper airflow experience far less mechanical strain over time.
  • Total Peace of Mind: You get long-lasting equipment backed by local warranties and friendly ongoing service.

settings.html: FAQs

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions

settings.html:
Heating installation means designing and installing a complete system from scratch where one doesn't exist—such as in a new construction build, room addition, or unconditioned space. Heating replacement means removing an existing furnace or heat pump and connecting a modern, high-efficiency unit into your home's pre-existing ductwork, gas lines, and wiring.

It's best to bring in an HVAC pro during the blueprint phase or right before framing starts. Planning early ensures there's plenty of room for duct runs, gas lines, and equipment closets without needing costly changes later on.

Both are great choices! Gas furnaces deliver powerful, rapid heat that copes effortlessly with sub-zero Iowa cold snaps. Cold-climate heat pumps (and hybrid systems) offer incredible energy efficiency and give you both heating and cooling in a single package.

We measure your space and run airflow calculations before placing any ductwork. By sizing supply lines correctly and installing adjustable dampers, we make sure warm air is distributed evenly across bedrooms, basements, and living spaces.

Total cost depends on your home's square footage, fuel type (gas vs. electric), ductwork needs, equipment efficiency ratings, and whether you need zoning controls. We provide free, upfront quotes so you know the exact cost before making any decisions.
